links.comparator_used: Other non-reasoning or earlier general-purpose LLMs, including other GPT-family models
links.outcome: Factual accuracy (hallucination rate) and rubric-based completeness
links.effect: o3 achieved the highest rubric score but produced inaccuracies more frequently than other GPT-family models; reasoning-optimized models did not consistently improve factuality.
links.tradeoff: Higher factual error rate (hallucinations) in o3 despite the top completeness score.
links.quote: Importantly, newer reasoning-optimized models did not consistently improve factuality: although o3 achieved the highest rubric score, it produced inaccuracies more frequently than other GPT-family models.

links.comparator_used: Same LLMs answering without web search enabled
links.effect: Gemini-2.5 Pro fell from 66.8% to 63.9% and GPT-5 fell from 73.8% to 72.8% when web search was enabled.
links.tradeoff: Web search did not improve responses; scores dropped slightly.
links.quote: The average score changed from 66.8% to 63.9% for Gemini-2.5 Pro and from 73.8% to 72.8% for GPT-5 when web search was enabled.
